The driver **does not own a memory map**. The only address the driver source expresses is the RAM base as `mmap_base = "0x0"` (`driver/run_plan.hpp:27`). #!/usr/bin/env bash
# QEMU-match feature: vsim `--print-qemu-config` emits the engine's QEMU
# `-readconfig` cfg -- its config.inc distilled to per-extension `[global]`
# properties -- and the andesim plan executor injects it into the QEMU fast leg
# so the functional engine runs the same ISA the cycle-accurate engine models.
#
# Two layers:
#   1. unit (fast, always runs): plan-test covers stage_qemu_cfg (probe ->
#      workdir/qemu.cfg, with the tolerant fallback) and the fast-leg-only
#      `-readconfig` injection. Pure; no engine.
#   2. engine contract (needs a built vsim engine; SKIPs otherwise):
#      sim_<cpu> --print-qemu-config exits 0 and emits a [global] block whose
#      driver is andes-<family>-riscv-cpu (the family the QEMU leg selects).
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

# 1. unit: stage_qemu_cfg + the -readconfig injection contract
bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
PLANTEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-plan-test"
[ -x "$PLANTEST" ] || fail "missing unit-test binary: $PLANTEST"
"$PLANTEST" >/dev/null || fail "plan unit tests (stage_qemu_cfg / -readconfig) failed"
ok "unit: stage_qemu_cfg + fast-leg -readconfig injection"

# 2. engine contract. Resolve a built vsim engine the way the driver does:
#    VSIM_BIN_DIR (env, then config.env) -- shared vsim_bin_dir from log.sh.
BINDIR=$(vsim_bin_dir)
SIM=$(ls "$BINDIR"/sim_* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "$SIM" ] || [ ! -x "$SIM" ]; then
  ok "SKIP engine contract: no built vsim engine under $BINDIR (set VSIM_BIN_DIR)"
  exit 0
fi

out=$("$SIM" --print-qemu-config 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "--print-qemu-config exit $rc: $out"
# family: sim_<family>_<variant> -> andes-<family>-riscv-cpu
base=$(basename "$SIM"); base=${base#sim_}; family=${base%%_*}
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '\[global\]' || fail "no [global] block: $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "andes-${family}-riscv-cpu" \
  || fail "driver not andes-${family}-riscv-cpu: $out"
ok "engine contract: $(basename "$SIM") --print-qemu-config -> andes-${family}-riscv-cpu cfg"

# 3. end-to-end (no spawn): `run --mode hybrid --dry-run` prints both legs, and
#    the QEMU leg carries -readconfig <cfg> -- i.e. the probe -> stage -> inject
#    chain is wired. Needs the andesim binary + a fixture ELF; SKIPs otherwise.
BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
elf=$(ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf 2>/dev/null \
      || ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/*.elf 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -x "$BIN" ] && [ -n "$elf" ]; then
  id="vsim:${base}"
  out=$(VSIM_BIN_DIR="$BINDIR" "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
        --dry-run --engine "$id" "$elf" 2>/dev/null)
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 2 command' \
    || fail "dry-run did not print 2 commands: $out"
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-readconfig' \
    || fail "dry-run QEMU leg missing -readconfig: $out"
  ok "dry-run: hybrid command preview shows both legs + -readconfig"
else

# andesim --print-memmap: plan draft (investigation in progress)

## Context

User request: add `--print-memmap` to andesim to print the memory map regions
supported in HYBRID mode. vsim has its own `--print-memmap` but the user
doubts its correctness, and it is not plumbed through andesim. Re-plan the
feature and verify correctness.

Key semantic (from docs/andes_sim_limitations.ipynb L7/L9): the hybrid-mode
memory map is the INTERSECTION of the QEMU map and the vsim map, plus
hybrid-specific reservations:
- Program RAM: base 0x0 (AE350 DRAM window 0x0..0x80000000), size = --mem-size
  (default 128 MB, cap 2 GiB - 4 KiB), shared mmap, content survives handoff.
- V-scratch: one reserved 4 KiB page at [mem-size, mem-size+4K).
- ILM/DLM/HVM apertures (engine-conditional, sizes from --describe; bases
  0xA0000000 / 0xA0200000 / 0x90000000): content crosses via sidecar files.
- Devices modeled by BOTH engines (safe in ROI, state does NOT cross):
  UART2 0xf0300000, SimControl/HTIF 0xe0080000. L2C window 0xE0500000 when
  engine has L2C.
- Everything else is engine-specific = NOT supported in hybrid.

## Findings so far (to be completed after agent reports)

### vsim --print-memmap (audit)
- `src/main.cpp:322` parses; `main.cpp:461` calls

# andesim --print-memmap: plan draft (investigation in progress)

## Context

User request: add `--print-memmap` to andesim to print the memory map regions
supported in HYBRID mode. vsim has its own `--print-memmap` but the user
doubts its correctness, and it is not plumbed through andesim. Re-plan the
feature and verify correctness.

Key semantic (from docs/andes_sim_limitations.ipynb L7/L9): the hybrid-mode
memory map is the INTERSECTION of the QEMU map and the vsim map, plus
hybrid-specific reservations:
- Program RAM: base 0x0 (AE350 DRAM window 0x0..0x80000000), size = --mem-size
  (default 128 MB, cap 2 GiB - 4 KiB), shared mmap, content survives handoff.
- V-scratch: one reserved 4 KiB page at [mem-size, mem-size+4K).
- ILM/DLM/HVM apertures (engine-conditional, sizes from --describe; bases
  0xA0000000 / 0xA0200000 / 0x90000000): content crosses via sidecar files.
- Devices modeled by BOTH engines (safe in ROI, state does NOT cross):
  UART2 0xf0300000, SimControl/HTIF 0xe0080000. L2C window 0xE0500000 when
  engine has L2C.
- Everything else is engine-specific = NOT supported in hybrid.

## Findings so far (to be completed after agent reports)

### vsim --print-memmap (audit)
- `src/main.cpp:322` parses; `main.cpp:461` calls
  `sim.platform.interconnect.dump_region()` then exits (before sc_start).
- `src/platform/interconnect.hpp:176` dump_region prints the REAL routing
  table (memory_regions from bind_target + reserved_regions). Not hardcoded.
- Correctness concerns identified:
  1. RAM region is computed from the CLI args of THIS invocation - running
     `--print-memmap` without `--shared-mem-size/base` prints the standalone
     default RAM window, not the hybrid run's actual one.
  2. Output does not distinguish bound targets from reserved holes (PLDM) -
     both print identically.
  3. Help text says shared-mem-base default 0x80000000 "QEMU virt RAM base" -
     stale vs AE350 (RAM base 0x0). Verify which default is actually used.
  4. Regions bound in simulator.hpp (slave bridge / slv_bfm / sys_adapter =
     ILM/DLM aperture, HVM) - conditional binds; check they appear.

### Bindings inventory (partial)
- platform.hpp: reserve PLDM; bind main_memory x2 (RAM + alias), sim_control,
  smu, uart1, uart2.
- simulator.hpp:164-198: conditional binds (slave-port bridge, slv_bfm,
  sys_adapter).

### QEMU AE350 map (agent 3 report, authoritative)
Source: qemu_andesim/hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c:69-133 memmap table.
- DRAM @ 0x0, 2 GiB window (alias of machine->ram; memory-backend-file mappable)
- MROM @ 0x80000000 (128 MiB) - RESET VECTOR target; NOR flash @ 0x88000000
- SimControl/HTIF @ 0xe0080000 (0x1000) - functional, mirrors vsim sim_control
- L2C reg window @ 0xe0500000 (1 MiB) - RAM stub, seeds CEN=1 at +0x8 (:1848)
- PLIC 0xe4000000/4M, PLMT 0xe6000000/1M, PLICSW 0xe6400000/4M
- SMU 0xf0100000/1M, UART1 0xf0200000 (serial_hd 1), UART2 0xf0300000 (console)
- PIT/WDT/RTC/DMAC/SDC/MAC/BMC + unimplemented stubs (LCD/SMC/SPI/GPIO/I2C/SND/SPI2)
- virtio-mmio x8 @ 0xfe000000; DTROM (FDT) @ 0xf2000000
- SUBPORT ILM/DLM backdoors: 8 harts x 2 MiB interleaved 0xa0000000..0xa1ffffff
  (always mapped; MMIO dispatch into per-hart LM)
- HVM RAM @ hvm_base (default 0x90000000), size 1<<hvm_size_pow_2 (default 1 B!)
  + HVM subport alias at same base by default
- Per-CPU ILM/DLM overlays: QOM props on riscv.andes.ae350.soc -
  ilm_base def 0 (!), dlm_base def 0x200000, sizes def 2 MiB, *_default_enable

  wrong for every engine.

## Part 1 - Audit verdict on vsim --print-memmap (VERIFIED, ran the binary)

Architecture is sound: `main.cpp:461` dumps the LIVE interconnect routing
table (`interconnect.hpp:176 dump_region()`), not a hardcoded list. But:

CONFIRMED BUGS (empirically, sim_ax45mpv_premium a4a4d13):
1. PRINT: every size is +1. `MemoryRegion.end_address` is exclusive
   (memory_region.hpp:28-29) yet dump prints `end - base + 1`
   (interconnect.hpp:182). e.g. UART prints `size: 0x100001`.
2. PRINT: upper bound printed is the EXCLUSIVE end but reads as inclusive
   (`uart2: [0xf0300000-0xf0400000]`; 0xf0400000 is not decoded).
3. DECODE BUG (worst): HVM aperture bound as
   `NDS_HVM_BASE + NDS_HVM_SIZE_KB * 0x1000 - 1` (simulator.hpp:162-173).
   KB needs *0x400; *0x1000 makes the window 4x too big: config 256 KiB,
   decoded+printed 1 MiB [0x90000000-0x90100000). QEMU maps 256 KiB
   (hvm_size_pow_2=18), so [0x90040000,0x90100000) DIVERGES between engines.
   Same engine's --describe says hvm_size=262144 - vsim self-contradicts.
4. SEMANTICS: ILM/DLM shown as ONE 4 MiB slave-port aperture
   [0xa0000000-0xa0400000) (simulator.hpp:180-184, memory_map.h) hiding real
   ILM=64K/DLM=32K. Reader infers 2M/2M.
5. Standalone RAM row is [0x0-0x90000000) = 2.25 GiB default window - not the
   hybrid window (hybrid = --shared-mem-size, driver-set), and it covers
   QEMU's MROM@0x80000000 + NOR@0x88000000 range. Printed map != hybrid truth.
6. Reserved PLDM row [0xe6800000) indistinguishable from routable targets.
7. RAM alias row [0x8_00000000) unreachable on these cores
   (NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH=32) - phantom.
8. By definition vsim-only: cannot answer "what does HYBRID support" (QEMU
   side absent: PLIC/PLMT/PLICSW/MROM/virtio... are QEMU-only regions).
